source: SSD1306 0.96 inch 128x64 I2C OLED module, vendor drawing (generalize/plan.json datasheet_note): board 27.3 x 27.8 mm, four 2.0 mm holes, active area 21.74 x 10.86 mm, viewing area about 25 x 14 mm, glass about 1.4 mm above the PCB. ASSUMED (not on the vendor sheet, uncertainty in the notes): PCB thickness 1.2 mm, hole inset 1.9 x 2.0 mm, glass outline 26.7 x 19.3 mm, glass 5.0 mm above the board's header edge, 4-pin header 2.54 mm pitch 2.0 mm from the header edge.
frame: module: origin at the PCB min corner, PCB bottom at Z = 0, glass on +Z, header edge at Y = 0

hole_from_x_edge.source: ASSUMED: hole centre from the short edge, 23.5 mm pattern; +/- 0.3

hole_from_y_edge.source: ASSUMED: hole centre from the long edge, 23.8 mm pattern; +/- 0.3

glass_length.source: ASSUMED glass outline (X) of the 0.96 inch panel; +/- 0.3

glass_height.source: vendor drawing: glass height above the PCB top

glass_y0.source: ASSUMED: glass lower edge from the header edge; +/- 1.0, measure the module

view_width.source: vendor drawing: viewing area X (no-clip zone)

view_height.source: vendor drawing: viewing area Y (no-clip zone)

view_clear_height.source: ASSUMED clear height in front of the glass reserved for the window; request/rules may override

pin_pitch.source: 4-pin 2.54 mm header (I2C: GND VCC SCL SDA)

pin_from_y_edge.source: ASSUMED header pin centre from the header edge; +/- 0.5

interfaces.source: catalogue data (generalize iteration 001, delta D1): the mounting-hole axis list, the plane the part rests on when seated over its holes, and the plane its component keep-out starts from

notes: Window rule inputs: ACTIVE area 21.74 x 10.86 must be fully visible with the request's margin (G05: at least 1 mm); the 25 x 14 view_zone must not be clipped by the wall. ASSUMPTIONS and uncertainty: PCB thickness 1.2 (+/-0.2); hole inset 1.9 x 2.0 (+/-0.3, so the 23.5 x 23.8 pattern is +/-0.6); glass outline 26.7 x 19.3 and glass_y0 5.0 (+/-1.0), so the active-area centre is assumed at the glass centre and may sit up to ~1 mm off (many modules offset the active area toward the far edge): measure the owner's module and override via the request. Module variants exist with the header on the top face. Import gate: bounding box of pcb equals the 27.3 x 27.8 x 1.2 size; HOLE direction is a unit vector; view zone inside the glass outline (self_checks).
